```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(glue)
library(rlang)
library(mirt)

source(here("02_score_data/02_fit_irt/registry_helper.R"))
```

```{r}
# read in all models in registry
mods_coded <- list_models() |> load_models() |> code_models()

all_coefs <- mods_coded |>
  mutate(coefs = map(mod_rec, levantemodels::mod_coefs)) |>
  select(task, model_set, subset, itemtype, nfact, invariance, coefs) |>
  unnest(coefs)

write_rds(all_coefs, here("02_scoring_outputs/all_coefs.rds"), compress = "gz")
```

```{r}
bad_d <- all_coefs |>
  filter_out(model_set == "multigroup_site") |>
  filter_out(subset == "overlap_items") |>
  filter(abs(difficulty) > 8) |>
  select(task, item, group, subset, a1, d, difficulty) |>
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), \(x) round(x, 3))) |>
  distinct() |>
  arrange(difficulty) |>
  filter_out(task %in% c("sds", "tom", "math"))

bad_d |>
  # select(item, group) |>
  mutate(subset = subset |>
           replace_values("es-CO" ~ "pilot_uniandes_co_bogota, pilot_uniandes_co_rural"),
         group = if_else(group == "all", subset, group)) |>
  arrange(item) |>
  group_by(item) |>
  summarise(exclusion_datasets = paste(group, collapse = ", ")) #|>
  # write_csv("exclusions_a1.csv")
```
